name: ChatHeader
intent: The bar at the top of the assistant: its mark and name, then start a new chat, go full screen, the options menu and close.
usage: Use ChatHeader at the top of an assistant panel or its full-screen view. It is one component: pass the handlers for the buttons you want, and the ones you leave out do not show. The options menu is built for you: Chats and Playbooks with how many there are, Plan Mode with a tick while it is on, and Settings. chatsCount and playbooksCount leave the number off when there is none. menu replaces the whole menu when a screen needs different entries. Pair it with ChatList, ChatMessage and ChatComposer to make the window. See contracts/chatheader.json for the full contract.

title.note: The name beside the mark. It also names the bar and the close button.

expanded.note: The full-screen view is showing, so the button offers the way back.

onExpandedChange.note: Adds the full-screen button. The screen decides what full screen means.

onClose.note: Adds the × that shuts the assistant.

chatsCount.note: How many saved chats. Nothing shows at zero.

playbooksCount.note: How many playbooks. Nothing shows at zero.

planMode.note: Plan Mode is on, so its row in the menu is ticked.

onPlanModeChange.note: Plan Mode was switched from the menu.

menu.note: Replaces the built-in options menu. With this, Plan Mode is yours to handle through onMenuSelect.

onMenuSelect.note: A pick from the menu: chats, playbooks, planMode, settings, or your own ids.

label.note: Names the bar for screen readers. Without it, the title.

useWhen: The top of an assistant side panel.
The top of the assistant's full-screen view.
doNot: Do not use it as the app's top bar. Use AppHeader.
Do not use it as a page title. Use PageHeader.
Do not build the bar from Buttons and a Logo, or add an AiHeader or CopilotBar. Use this.
Do not show a count of zero.
a11y: The bar is a header named after the assistant, holding a heading with its name.
Every button says what it does, with a kit Tooltip on hover and focus.
The options menu is a kit DropdownMenu, so it is reachable with the keyboard and Plan Mode reads as ticked.

examples.title: The bar
examples.usage: With everything on, and with only the menu and close.
